about.en: GNS is the native token of Gains Network, the developer of gTrade, a decentralized leveraged trading platform for crypto, forex, stocks and commodities built on synthetic, oracle-priced markets. GNS absorbs protocol fees through buybacks and burns and backs the platform's vaults. It is issued by the project on Arbitrum at 0x18c11fd286c5ec11c3b683caa813b77f5163a122 and on Polygon at 0xe5417af564e4bfda1c483642db72007871397896, with further project deployments on Base, ApeChain and MegaETH.
